audit.why: 50.65% over 2902 games — a genuinely even lane where Diana leads early, gives up level 3 to the taunt, and takes it back on burst.
audit.corrected: Even-to-slightly-favoured for Diana; the danger is Hero's Entrance affecting the map, not the 1v1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart read Galio/Galio/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill against win[N] of Diana/Diana/Galio/Diana/Diana/Diana/Diana — every row disagreed across layers, and the one stage Galio actually owns was labelled 'Skill'.

audit.corrected: Sides aligned to win[N] and phases[2].why rewritten to state why level 3 is his — Shield of Durand's taunt plus the Justice Punch knock-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated ability names: 'Bulwark's Signal (W)' in spikes[0].text and content.late and wants.foe[0] — Galio's W is Shield of Durand; and 'Runic Skin' for his passive — it is Colossal Smash. wants.you[2] calls Justice Punch his Q; it is his E. breakdown.cooldowns had no number, and two bullets were the trade lines pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Riot text: Colossal Smash (P) is a periodic empowered attack (an auto-reset tell); Winds of War (Q) 11/10/9/8/7; Shield of Durand (W) 18/17/16/15/14, charges then taunts; Justice Punch (E) 11/10/9/8/7, dash with a knock-up that stops Diana's Lunar Rush; Hero's Entrance (R) 180/160/140.
audit.corrected: Real names and slots used, real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, and the Colossal Smash wind-up named as the tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions lists dash-denial by Justice Punch and the Colossal Smash auto-reset tell; neither appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Justice Punch knocks up the first champion it meets, which cancels Diana mid-Lunar Rush; the passive's empowered attack is the wind-up cue.
audit.corrected: Both stated — the dash denial in breakdown.cooldowns, the reset tell in dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: E pull joins... no — your dash threat begins: Q-mark into E reset chases are live; trade on every landed crescent.
edits.after: Shield of Durand comes online at 18s and Justice Punch knocks you up — the level 3 brawl belongs to him, not you.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Pale Cascade for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 and 7s at rank 5 — his only engage, and its knock-up cancels you mid-Lunar Rush. - Shield of Durand taunts on 18s. - Hero's Entrance is 180s at rank 1. - Pale Cascade is 15s.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: Pale Cascade is 15s at rank 1 — pop the orbs on the way out so the shield eats his taunt damage, not the wave's.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Colossal Smash is his opener: the wind-up auto is the tell, and at even HP his taunt turns your trade into his fight.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Carry by killing Galio before Hero's Entrance lands — 180s at rank 1, and he cannot peel what he cannot reach.

edits.before: Your Q-W-E burst punishes Galio before he has Bulwark's Signal (W) shield uptime or enough magic resist stacking from Runic Skin to tank your all-in comfortably.
edits.after: Your Q-W-E burst punishes Galio before Shield of Durand (W) is up often enough, and before his ranks and resistances let him tank your all-in comfortably.

edits.before: By full build Galio has shifted almost entirely into a teamfight/peel and roam-ult tool rather than a lane threat, so your job is bursting him down before he can use Bulwark's Signal to protect a teammate or ult in to save a fight. Punish his split push attempts directly since he still lacks true mobility outside of his hook-in engage.
edits.after: By full build Galio has shifted almost entirely into a teamfight/peel and roam-ult tool rather than a lane threat, so your job is bursting him down before he can taunt with Shield of Durand to protect a teammate or ult in to save a fight. edits.before: Farm safely behind Bulwark's Signal shield and passive MR stacking
edits.after: Farm safely behind Shield of Durand and stack up his resistances
